text:
Elena: Quick capture from today's ClearWave onboarding call 1 they handed us two asks that could sway their renewal in ~6w: (A) a single downloadable CSV that maps route -> token usage -> cost (they want to hand this to FP&A), (B) a way to mute non-actionable alerts during business hours (their PMs are getting hammered).
Marco: Can someone paste the exact phrasing they used? Need quotes for productboard.
Elena: Quote: 'Please give us one export we can send to finance. Right now it's a bunch of manual screenshots and guesswork.' Also: 'Our PMs get pinged during standup and it's noise, we need quiet windows.'
Priya: Flagging renewal risk + ask to prioritize. If we ship a credible interim before renewal it de-escalates.
Ravi: Quick dev take: interim CSV (route + token counts) + download endpoint + small UI link ~2w if we can reuse aggregated counters. Accurate $ cost column requires joining with pricing tiers and per-token unitization: add'l 2-3w and a short QA pass. Alert snooze (org-level quiet hours + per-route mute) behind flag ~1w.
AM-Jess: They explicitly requested cost columns. But they said they'd accept interim counts if we promise beta access for the full cost export. They offered to test.
Elena: They sent a sample CSV layout in the call notes, uploaded to the shared CS drive (link).
Marco: Product ask: can we offer a temporary manual process we own? e.g., CS runs the export once/week and sends until product ships? Might buy time.
Priya: Good stopgap. But we should avoid creating operational bottleneck. Offer as an option, not the only path.
product-bot: Created PB-6782 "ClearWave: consolidated route usage export + alert-snooze" tags=[cs, renewal-risk, telemetry].
devops-bot: Noted: potential infra spike for export if export hits high cardinality. Recommend rate-limit and background job.
Ravi: I'll spike the aggregation dependency tomorrow and post a short tech note. If aggregations exist, interim ship in 2w; full cost columns in 4-5w.
AM-Jess: I'll log renewal checkpoint and tell the AE to surface this in the exec renewal conversation.
Elena: Actions: 1) Ravi to confirm aggregation dependency and ETA in 48h, 2) AM-Jess to confirm beta participants and escalation path, 3) Marco to add stopgap CS-managed export option to PB-6782. Check-in Friday.
Marco: Adding impact estimate to PB item.
Priya: I'll add this to the weekly renewal sweep and flag as high-touch.
Elena: Thanks team. Keeping this hot; will post call recording and the sample CSV in the thread. :thumbsup:
product-bot: PB-6782 updated with note 'customer to beta test full cost export, interim counts export planned'.
